findings.title: Recognition names a responsible, changeable state
findings.claim: The question holds knowing, doing, and the former state of ignorance together: naming the past as ignorance explains how the deed arose without removing the deed from its agents, while leaving a path toward accountable recognition.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers عَلِمْتُمْ, فَعَلْتُمْ, and جَٰهِلُونَ connect through the supplied wider notes: deeds remain known and attributable, action remains recorded and answerable, and ignorant or impatient action can produce harm. The carriers therefore make the closing state a condition surrounding the act rather than an erasure of agency.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive both the brothers' failure of recognition and the continuing ownership of what they did; change in knowledge does not require pretending the earlier act did not happen.
findings.containment: This retains the knowing, doing, ignorance, and rashness relations together without selecting between the supplied facets. It does not claim that ignorance is a legal excuse, import an unsupplied confession text, or turn the global connections into a replacement for the focus wording.

epistemic.reason: The focus surface and one citable trusted publication directly support the relation, but the independent connection targets provide notes without target morphology and therefore qualify the global extension.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The addressed perfect form carries knowing and recognizing the deed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 82:12 keeps particular deeds known and attributable even when their doers acted ignorantly.
branch_activations.activation: The focus question asks whether the agents know; the wider accountability note makes that knowledge a return to an attributable deed rather than a merely private mental state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Knowing becomes the recognition that reconnects the agents to what they did.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the knowing and recognition facet is activated; no wider claim about every knowledge branch is made.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, iş veya başka bir şey türünden bir olayı ortaya çıkarma ve gerçekleştirmedir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 54:52 makes deeds enduringly recorded and keeps action attributable.
branch_activations.activation: The focus object is not an abstract possibility: the wider deed-recording note returns the bare action to an event that remains attached to its doers.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What was done remains a concrete, attributable act even as its former state is named.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not receive a newly specified crime label from this activation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin zihninde bir şey veya durum hakkında bilgi bulunmaz ve kişi onu tanımaz.
branch_activations.carrier: The closing active participle names the brothers' former lack of knowledge or recognition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 49:6 links ignorant action to harm and regret and requires matters to be established before acting.
branch_activations.activation: The wider warning gives the focus state a concrete epistemic consequence: not knowing what is being acted on can produce injury while the action remains real.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Ignorance explains the misrecognition around the deed without dissolving its consequences.
branch_activations.boundary: The false-belief specialization is not separately asserted here.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi yapılması gereken doğru biçime aykırı ve ölçüsüz davranır.
branch_activations.carrier: The same closing predicate can name conduct that departed from proper restraint.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 46:23 distinguishes bounded knowledge from an ignorant, impatient response.
branch_activations.activation: The independent impatient-response contrast gives the past ignorance a behavioral shape that reaches the brothers' act, not only their state of mind.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The remembered deed is also seen as a lapse of restraint, held alongside the lack of recognition.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that provocation or anger is the sole cause; the restraint facet remains coexisting and qualified.

findings.title: Knowledge returns as a recognition mark
findings.claim: The knowing question can gather a wider recognition-mark resonance: the deed becomes the sign by which those who failed to see it come to identify what is before them.
findings.mechanism: The focus form عَلِمْتُمْ carries knowing and recognition, while the supplied retrospective support names later recognition and 12:96 supplies a story-level trigger in which the arriving shirt becomes a sign of restored sight. The contact returns through the focus knowledge word rather than through an unanchored general thesis.
findings.reader_payoff: The question is heard as asking not only whether knowledge exists, but whether the agents can now recognize the deed as the mark that identifies their own past.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual resonance of the distinguishing-sign branch. It does not make عَلِمْتُمْ literally mean a shirt, and it does not treat the legacy reference to 12:90 as independently analyzed target evidence.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support is legacy-unbound and the connection target lacks supplied morphology, but both the focus carrier and the sign/recognition contact are explicit in the packet.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The knowing form can carry the recognition of a distinguishing mark.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied retrospective record names recognition in 12:90, and 12:96 describes the shirt's arrival as a sign of restored sight.
branch_activations.activation: The focus question's knowledge carrier meets the later sign-and-sight pattern, so recognition becomes the act of reading the deed as an identifying trace.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The past deed itself becomes a mark through which the agents recognize what they had failed to recognize.
branch_activations.boundary: The sign facet is qualified and does not activate the other عَلِمَ branches or supply unprovided morphology for 12:96.

findings.title: The affected brother is also the bond under repair
findings.claim: The object phrase keeps the remembered injury inside a brotherhood, while the kinship carrier can also open onto the protected bond and mutual obligation that reconciliation must restore.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence أَخِي names a brother as an affected person. The independent 49:10 and 59:10 connections return through brotherhood, reconciliation, forgiveness, and the removal of inward rancor, activating both the kinship core and the abstract bond extension.
findings.reader_payoff: The question reaches beyond two injured individuals to the relationship in which the injury occurred and whose repair remains possible.
findings.containment: Only the kinship and protected-relationship facets are retained. The physical ring sense and the friendship-only source variant are not activated, and the connection targets are qualified because their morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and authored connection notes are explicit, but the branch is itself qualified and the wider target morphology is unavailable.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel alan, erkek ve kadın kardeşleri ve aralarındaki doğum ya da soy bağını kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: أَخِي directly carries the brotherhood relation in the affected-person phrase.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 49:10 frames brotherhood through reconciliation, and 59:10 pairs brotherhood with forgiveness and removal of rancor.
branch_activations.activation: The wider reconciliation ethic returns to the focus kinship word and makes the relation itself part of what the question exposes.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The remembered act is harm within a brotherhood, not only an isolated act against two named people.
branch_activations.boundary: The source variant about friends is not activated; this remains a kinship reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Soyut uzantı, korunup gözetilmesi gereken ilişkiyi, hakkı veya karşılıklı yükümlülüğü belirtir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The question opens a protected relationship that has been violated and can be restored.
branch_activations.boundary: No physical tether or general obligation outside this brotherhood relation is claimed.

findings.title: Ignorance includes acting without a sign
findings.claim: The closing state can also be felt as having acted without the sign or advance information that would have made the situation recognizable before the harm was done.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier جَٰهِلُونَ supports the sign-deprivation branch, while 17:36 forbids acting on what one does not know and 49:6 links uninformed action to harm and regret. Those independent triggers return through the closing state and materially widen ignorance from an inner defect to a missing basis for action.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why the question presses knowledge so sharply: the failure was not only what the brothers felt, but what they proceeded to do without a reliable sign of what they were doing.
findings.containment: Only the core lack-of-sign facet is retained. No literal road, landmark, animal-mark, or other specialized image is asserted, and the sign resonance does not replace the ordinary ignorance reading.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and independent connection notes provide a coherent carrier-trigger relation, but connection target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Arazi, yol bulmayı sağlayacak bilgi, belirti, dağ veya başka bir işaret bulunmadığı için tanınmaz.
branch_activations.carrier: جَٰهِلُونَ can carry the state of being without the information or sign needed for recognition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 17:36 forbids following what one does not know, while 49:6 links uninformed action to harm and regret.
branch_activations.activation: The two wider warnings supply the missing-sign condition as an independent trigger for the focus ignorance state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Ignorance becomes an absence of the reliable mark that should have oriented action, while the resulting act remains accountable.
branch_activations.boundary: The extension to specialized unrecognized-animal uses is not activated.

findings.title: The spoken question is itself a disclosure act
findings.claim: The opening speech frame makes the question an act that brings concealed conduct into the open, rather than a neutral wrapper around information already available.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier قَالَ activates the spoken-word core. Wider connections contrast speech with action and public speech with what remains hidden yet known; those triggers return through the uttered question and make saying the past part of the change in its meaning.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question does something: it turns hidden conduct into shared, speakable knowledge without changing the plain content of what was done.
findings.containment: The speech core is retained without activating lying, inner unspoken speech, negotiation, or imposed judgment. The target connection morphologies are not supplied, so the global effect remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The focus speech carrier is exact and the two connection notes independently supply speech/action and hidden/public contrasts, but their target morphology is unavailable.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: قَالَ carries the act of bringing the question into spoken form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 26:226 contrasts speech with action, and 36:76 contrasts public speech with what is hidden yet known.
branch_activations.activation: The wider speech/action and hidden/public contrasts return through Joseph's utterance and make the spoken question the means by which concealed conduct becomes exposed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The saying is a disclosure event that changes the social availability of the remembered deed.
branch_activations.boundary: The word is not treated as a lie, an inner thought, or a general theory of speech.

findings.title: The deed includes conduct and the cover made around it
findings.claim: The bare action word can hold both the conduct itself and the constructed cover that carried it: the remembered doing remains morally evaluable and includes the fabricated evidence surrounding the harm.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier فَعَلْتُمْ activates the personal-act facet through wider notes about hostility, partiality, and transgression, while 12:18 independently records fabricated evidence and concealment around the brothers' act. The same action carrier therefore returns through both moral conduct and made cover.
findings.reader_payoff: What the question asks them to know is not reduced to a single physical moment; it includes the behavior that produced the injury and the story or evidence constructed to hide it.
findings.containment: These are contextual resonances of the broad action field, not a claim that the focus verb lexically means hostility, injustice, or fabrication in isolation. The ordinary question about what was done remains intact.

epistemic.reason: The focus action carrier and direct 12:18 concealment connection are supplied, while the wider ethical connections provide authored notes without target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Aynı biçim tek kişinin iyi veya kötü işi için, övgü ve yergi bağlamında da kullanılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: فَعَلْتُمْ can denote a personally attributable act under moral evaluation, whether praised or condemned.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:2 links hostility to transgression, and 5:8 sets justice against hatred and partiality.
branch_activations.activation: The ethical triggers return through the bare action carrier and supply the conduct-level frame for the brothers' doing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The remembered act is conduct whose moral quality is exposed by the hostility and partiality surrounding it.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the good-or-bad personal-act facet is activated; no separate good-work reading is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, yalan veya düzme sözü uydurup kurmadır.
branch_activations.carrier: The broad action carrier can include something made and arranged around the central act.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 12:18 records the brothers' fabricated evidence and the concealment surrounding the act.
branch_activations.activation: The direct same-surah trigger supplies a concrete made-cover contact for the otherwise broad focus action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The question's remembered doing can include the fabricated account that concealed what happened.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb is not reduced to lying, and no claim is made that fabrication is the only deed being recalled.
